summary: Iteration 4 backend + frontend fully verified. Backend pytest: 50/50 PASS (100%). Added a new TestPinAuth class (8 tests) that covers /api/auth/pin-status role-guard, first-signin-without-PIN 400, PIN-length 400, first-signin creates the PIN and returns a sanitized {id,name,role} projection with pin-status flipping has_pin=True, subsequent-wrong-PIN 401, subsequent-correct-PIN 200 with same id, legacy seeded user (Sam Carter) can set a PIN, boss/admin still sanitized, and GET /api/users never leaks password. Migrated the shared `actors` fixture to unique per-run TEST_* names with random 4-digit PINs so pytest is idempotent across runs (old fixture called signin without a PIN which is now a 400). All existing suites (Auth boss/admin, Floors, Checklist, Push, Visits 3-day rule + room_name, Buildings/Rooms, Memos/Photos, Tasks, Chat, Numbers) continue to pass. Frontend (mobile viewport 390x900) verified via Playwright: (1) role-cleaner -> signin-name-input -> signin-continue -> signin-pin-input flow works. Brand-new name renders 'Create a 4-digit PIN' label; on second sign-in of that name it renders "Enter <first>'s 4-digit PIN". Wrong PIN surfaces 'Incorrect PIN' in signin-error; correct PIN routes to /(tabs)/floorplan. (2) Teacher RoomSheet: Checklist section (heading and testID checklist-input) is ABSENT and Photos section (heading and testID add-room-photo) is ABSENT. Status controls, Memos, and the 'Book this room (Teacher In)' calendar are still rendered. (3) Cleaner regression: Checklist section (count>=1) and checklist-input (count>=1) are present in RoomSheet. (4) Role gating regression: boss role opens signin-password-input only (no signin-name-input), 'Scharf' signs in; admin 'gobigred' signs in. Teacher shows Calendar tab in bottom bar; cleaner shows Chats. (5) Local notifications are Platform.OS!=='web' so cannot be verified in the web preview -- MessageNotifier renders null on web and chat POST /conversations/{id}/messages still returns 200 with the message persisted (covered in TestPush.test_message_send_nonblocking_when_push_fails). Deprecated packages detected: none (react-native-safe-area-context, expo-image, expo-linear-gradient, expo-haptics all current). Carried-over non-blocking RN Web warnings from iterations 1-3 (shadow* style props, props.pointerEvents on floorplan.tsx) still present; unchanged in this iteration.

minor.issue: list_users() pops 'password' but does NOT pop 'pin_hash'. pin_hash is a bcrypt hash so leak severity is low, but sensitive material should not be returned to any client. Recommend adding u.pop('pin_hash', None) alongside the existing password pop in server.py list_users (~line 331).

react_native_issues.issue: Console warning '"shadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "boxShadow".' — likely in /app/frontend/src/theme.ts (shadow.card / shadow.lg). Non-blocking; carried over from iterations 1-3.

Console warning 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents' — /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/floorplan.tsx around line 314 (zoomHint uses pointerEvents="none" as a prop). Non-blocking; carried over.

action_items: (LOW security) In backend/server.py list_users, also pop 'pin_hash' from returned user docs so bcrypt hashes are never returned by GET /api/users.
(Optional/LOW - carried over) Migrate shadow.card / shadow.lg in src/theme.ts from shadow* props to boxShadow for RN Web.
(Optional/LOW - carried over) In app/(tabs)/floorplan.tsx line 314, move pointerEvents='none' into the style prop.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py auth/signin: sanitized response is enforced by pub() which correctly returns only {id,name,role}. Verified end-to-end that pin_hash and password never appear in the signin response body.

server.py auth/signin cleaner/teacher branch: when user has no pin yet (seeded/legacy), the first valid 4-digit PIN sets pin_hash. Behavior matches the PRD ('first sign-in for a name CREATES the PIN'). No name collision or downgrade path.
server.py list_users: security minor — pin_hash is NOT scrubbed (only password is). Recommend popping pin_hash to be consistent with the pub() sanitization used everywhere else.
server.py PIN_RE = ^\d{4}$ — good, rejects non-numeric and off-length pins with 400 before hashing.
MessageNotifier.tsx: web-safe no-op via Platform.OS==='web' early return. Baseline pass (`primed`) prevents old-message spam. Non-blocking try/catch on network. Good.

auth.tsx two-step flow correctly delegates step-1 to /auth/pin-status and only shows the pin field on step 2. Enter/Continue buttons are correctly wired via canContinue/canSubmit. testIDs match PRD (signin-continue, signin-pin-input, signin-submit, signin-error).

RoomSheet.tsx: both Checklist and Photos blocks are guarded by `role !== 'teacher'`. The photos block is additionally guarded by `!isStructure`, which is correct (stairs/hallway hide photos for everyone).
(carried) PUT /api/buildings/{id} still lacks role-based auth check; low priority given the lightweight-auth style of the rest of the app.

NEW PIN-auth testIDs on /auth: signin-name-input (step 1), signin-continue (step 1 button), signin-pin-input (step 2), signin-submit (step 2 button), signin-error (error text), signin-password-input (boss/admin single-step). Boss password-only ('Scharf' case-insensitive, NO name); admin 'gobigred' case-insensitive. Instead call /api/auth/pin-status first, then signin with a 4-digit pin, or use a fresh unique name. Teacher RoomSheet correctly hides Checklist AND Photos sections; cleaner/boss/admin still see them. MessageNotifier is a no-op on web (Platform.OS==='web' early return) — cannot verify local notifications via Playwright; verify only that chat send still succeeds. GET /api/users currently leaks pin_hash (see minor issue) — fix is a one-liner in list_users.
